title: VIXEN public headers are not compiled with the consumers' warning set (-Wall -Wextra -Werror)
body: VIXEN's own WSL and native builds do not compile its public RenderGraph headers with the flags KFR's kfr_renderer uses under GCC (-Wall -Wextra -Werror). Batch vx10 lane commit 1704e86cb (default typed node factories through CRTP) made consumer TUs instantiate the VariadicTypedNode default virtuals, and the native boot product build failed with -Werror=unused-parameter at VariadicTypedNode.h:507/654/661/675 (PushConstantGathererNodeConfig); the header defect reached the landing and was found only by the native boot. A cheap guard is a VIXEN test target that includes the public RenderGraph headers and instantiates the default typed nodes under the KFR flags.

title: Pin bumps must provision the keyed Gaia fetch cache on both nodes and keep the three gaia.pin copies identical
body: VIXEN lane cx-gaiaarena1 moved VIXEN/dependencies/native/gaia.pin to 0ff5e6f9a but the kernel and undertow toolchain/providers/gaia.pin copies were left to follow; native boot failed with a Gaia revision mismatch and the kernel CodegenTool native-compile tests (204 CG tests) failed with 'Native-compile tests require Gaia 0ff5e6f9a ... searched ~/.cache/vixen-fetchcontent-cache/gaia-0ff5e6f9/gaia-src' until the keyed cache dir was provisioned by hand. The landing lane copied the pin file to all copies and provisioned the cache; a gate should make a VIXEN gaia.pin change fail unless the kernel/undertow copies are byte-identical, and a pin bump should provision the cache on both nodes.
